name: Huntington Square
summary: Huntington Square is a community shopping center on Long Island's North Shore, owned by Federal Realty Investment Trust. Located along Jericho Turnpike in East Northport, it serves affluent suburban communities with a convenient mix of national retailers and specialty shops.
demographics: Huntington Square attracts a diverse, affluent suburban demographic from East Northport and surrounding Long Island communities, with a strong representation of families and professionals aged 35-65. The trade area serves middle to upper-middle income households with median incomes significantly above the national average, typical of Suffolk County's North Shore region. Primary shoppers include working parents seeking convenient access to everyday necessities and specialty retail, as well as retirees and empty-nesters who value quality shopping experiences close to home.
description: Huntington Square is a well-established community shopping center located at 4000 Jericho Turnpike in East Northport, New York, serving the prosperous North Shore communities of Long Island. Owned and managed by Federal Realty Investment Trust, a premier real estate investment trust known for developing and operating high-quality retail properties, Huntington Square has been a cornerstone of the local retail landscape for decades. The center offers a convenient mix of national retailers, specialty shops, and service providers that cater to the daily needs and lifestyle preferences of the surrounding affluent suburban population. With its accessible location along the heavily-traveled Jericho Turnpike corridor, the shopping center provides ample parking and a comfortable open-air shopping environment. Huntington Square maintains strong community ties and continues to serve as a vital retail destination for East Northport residents and visitors from across Suffolk County.
